notes.title: Play! - Last Update News Final 3.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/271877ef0ea459594fe40418828411338b08e71f.png[/img]

[b]Hello! This is Otter Cat. Version 3.0 update completed[/b]

Another type of defense game has been updated
You can select it by clicking GameStart in the lobby UI

The third game is Adventure Mode

In Game Shortcuts (Keyboard)
Esc : Game Menu
Tab : Game Speed Control(Need Unlock)

- Move & Attack
Arrow keys : Move
S : Jump
D : Attack (Possible pressing)

you must select a game type
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/28b35bae13fac1643c899620c7ba5fdda0f1294c.png[/img]

Eliminate all enemies that come to the pig. The pig and you share HP.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/7ddef362161bae0957b833db25b43527bef3ce5d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/815ab185179d97695888b6a57a795d2da0a3356c.png[/img]

Explore the map using ladders and bottom jumps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/780fc69117aecb451b1d8c2ca96920956269bc31.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/5aa91bdc9fe66e177261d1df9122e50eb9de1776.png[/img]

The golden goblin that appears occasionally is a very good guy. 
When you kill it, there is a chance that you will be given a reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/1a5a44b01a28a44fd0a50893eae614c997b92c4e.png[/img]

Choices make you stronger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/b389280bcf860349673b24400be386286fa31ed7.png[/img]
You might make a friend
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/293a11566fb03e196876a5d7b059e85deca5b254.png[/img]

In addition to enemies, various obstacles will also bother you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/824a834ea456c69f0d93ad6274dc7458411801d9.png[/img]
Obstacles will stun, decrease your HP, or slow you down.

Bug reports and feedback are a huge help to me. 
[b]Thanks for enjoying![/b]

notes.title: Update & Bug Fix 2.0.5
notes.content:
A bug occurred during the game and was fixed.   :0

1. Fixed a bug where you completed the 100wave mission in game type "Build" but did not receive the cursor as a reward.
2. The number of "Workman" pools has been modified. There is a game reward when the entire pool is filled.
3. Fixed a bug where the 50wave and 5th boss did not die.
4. Some game optimizations have been made.

[u][b]AND[/b][/u]
A ranking system is being prepared.
Ranks 1 to 3 are displayed.

Thanks

notes.title: Play! - Update News 2.0
notes.content:
Hello! This is Otter Cat.
[b]Version 2.0[/b] update has been completed

Other types of defense games have been updated
You can select it by clicking GameStart in the lobby UI

The second game is in endless mode
Please keep killing the mobs

When you first start, you must select a game type
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/03808ebf053fe376b12ddc06ab1b64a978944d56.jpg[/img]

You can summon and evolve.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/87e81ad04c8f163482acfae71e46f6d6d7fb3fa5.jpg[/img]

Summon bosses and get lucky! Greed is not good
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/2b73c59d068060e5b0c30a04115960baca334073.jpg[/img]

Upgrading your weapon makes it more powerful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/7c967476a7864877e204627c0b91b2dc99ab006c.jpg[/img]

You can hire workers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836450/f277b0f7236a3b960c3cdefea78bbab0d076553c.jpg[/img]

Complete the game with your desires and choices

InGame Shortcuts (Keyboard)
Esc: Game Menu
Tab: GameSpeed Control (requires Unlock)
Space: Move camera to default position
` : Camera fixed

-Select Target
C: Summon and Evolve
X: Sell (only available in GameType Build)
Key 1~5
- Build: select Build
-Spawn: upgrade Unit

thank you

notes.title: Coming Soon - Patch News! (Ver 2.0)
notes.content:
Hello!
A different type of defense game will be released at the end of March.
It's a shame that the first game went differently than I wanted.
We are trying to create a game that relies more on luck.


- Here is a brief summary.
1. [b]Map is added.[/b]
The game style is determined by the map.
At startup, the map selection UI is displayed.

2. [b]You need to build a deck.[/b]
When you start, you need to create a deck that suits your style.

3. [b]The building spawn system has been changed.[/b]
You must spawn in a designated space.

4. [b]Upgrades and worker systems are introduced.[/b]
It's your choice whether to strengthen your units or invest money.

Finally
We plan to make this game available in a total of 3 types.
After Ver2.0, infinite mode and time attack mode were added, and 3.0 development and multiplayer and mobile versions are also in preparation.

Thank you
